full_text:
Red Vampress is a blue-skinned Draco-Titan. Like her vampiric name suggests, she dons a high-collared red and black vampire's cloak. Her Amulet is in the possession of Celina, a minion of Professor Rickman.

History

Red Vampress was invoked by Celina in the underwater city of Ys alongside Bonnie's Geisha. She fought and defeated Dante Vale's Freelancer. However the tables turned when Zhalia Moon arrived and Red Vampress was defeated by King Basilisk. Her Seeker, Celina, was then arrested by the Huntik Foundation. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

Abilities

Red Vampress can fight aggressively, with her razor sharp fangs and claws being lethal enough to send an enemy Titan back to its Amulet.

Gallery

Image caption: Red Vampress' Amulet

Image caption: Red Vampress

Trivia

• Red Vampress is based on the Vampire legends like Antedeluvian.
• It also could be a reference to Sheridan Le Fanu's Carmilla.
